title: Zone: Tick & Systems
description: Where the tick thread spends its time: stages, phases, systems, posted work, the sync to clients, and the failures the zone survives.

panels.title: Tick thread busy
panels.description: Seconds of work per second. The loop sleeps for what is left of each step; at 1.0 there is nothing left and steps start to be dropped.

panels.title: Share of ticks within budget
panels.description: The tick histogram has buckets at half, one and two budgets (25, 50 and 100 ms at 20 Hz). A tick over the 1x bucket is late.

panels.title: Late ticks and dropped steps
panels.description: A dropped step is world time that never ran; the walk rubber-banding bug was this.

panels.title: Tick split by stage
panels.description: Posted work at the start of the tick, the systems, deferred structural changes, and the sync half that follows.

panels.title: Systems split by phase
panels.description: Scheduler overhead is deciding what is due; it is in no system's own timer.

panels.title: Time per system
panels.description: The ten systems that take the most wall time. Narrow with the System variable.

panels.title: Slowest single update
panels.description: The longest one update took in the last ten seconds. A system can be cheap on average and still blow a tick now and then; this is where it shows. 0 means it did not run in that window.

panels.title: Cost over the selected range
panels.description: Share of wall time per system over the time range selected above.

panels.title: Posted work
panels.description: Tick-lane messages, skill resolutions and leases run on the tick thread. tick_start is inside the tick, between_steps eats the sleep.

panels.title: Tick thread standing still for a lease
panels.description: An IO thread borrows the world for a block (a DB transaction around ECS access); the tick waits until it is back.

panels.title: Wait for a lease
panels.description: How long a borrowing thread waits for the tick thread to get to its request.

panels.title: Dirty-log entries per tick
panels.description: Components marked dirty since the last tick. Stale entries have nothing left to send (removed, replaced or already sent), which is normal.

panels.title: Batches and updates per tick
panels.description: Updates divided by batches is how much each player hears per tick.

panels.title: Entities coming into view
panels.description: Entities sent whole because they entered someone's view; a login into dense ground makes this spike.

panels.title: Rate by kind
panels.description: Each of these is logged at most once a second, so the log understates a flood. All are bugs: tick_sql is SQL on the tick thread, query_skip an entity a system threw on, deferred_failure a structural change that threw, posted_failure a posted task that threw, outbox_failure a batch that could not be sent, sync_failure an entity that could not describe itself, tick_failure a whole tick that threw.

panels.title: Systems disabled
panels.description: Switched off after failing five ticks in a row; they stay off until the zone restarts.
